summary: Backend testing completed for Most Read Widget, Push Notifications, and Smart Content Prioritization features. 16 tests passed, 6 skipped due to CRITICAL route order bug in /api/articles/most-read endpoint.

critical.issue: Route returns 404 - 'most-read' is matched as article_id by /api/articles/{article_id} route. The route @api_router.get('/articles/most-read') at line 3165 is defined AFTER @api_router.get('/articles/{article_id}') at line 2281. FastAPI matches routes in order, so 'most-read' is treated as an article_id.
critical.fix: Move the /api/articles/most-read route definition BEFORE /api/articles/{article_id} in server.py (move lines 3165-3242 to before line 2281)
